messages:
maria_p: Preflight for tonight's deploy (02:00-04:00 UTC). Need: final internal blurb + who runs canary and pins staff announce. Rollback criteria? artifact naming?

jordan: I can run the canary and pin after global. Rollback criteria proposal: error-rate increase >1.5% OR P95 latency +200ms sustained over 3x5m windows -> rollback to v1.28.4.

sachin: Draft blurb: 'Rolling v1.29.0 — runtime perf & cost: KV-cache fix, updated quant profiles (Llama family), and a rate-limit safety patch. Expected ~30% per-token cost reduction for streaming RLHF workloads. Canary EU then global. Rollback: >1.5% error-rate spike or P95 +200ms.'

maria_p: Good. Add "global promotion ~45-90m after canary if stable" and CI should tag artifact as v1.29.0+{short_sha} for deterministic rollbacks.

deploy-bot: artifact tagging enabled. Will publish v1.29.0+{short_sha}. Deploy request queued: run_id=DB-20260321-88, user=jordan, target=canary.eu, version=v1.29.0. Reply "confirm" to execute.

jordan: confirm

deploy-bot: deploy started: DB-20260321-88. provisioning -> success. apply bundle -> success. warming KV -> in progress.

ops-oncall: I'm oncall for window. Ping @ops-oncall at start. I'll have rollback scripts and traffic-split ready. SRE snippet for RN: evict-cache command, path to quant profiles, metrics to watch: model_serving:error_rate, model_serving:latency_p95.

jordan: 30m snapshot: error_rate +0.1% (0.4%->0.5%), P95 +35ms. No alerts. Promoting to global now.

deploy-bot: promotion started: DB-20260321-88 -> global.

jordan: promoted. Posted metrics: https://internal.metrics/snapshots/DB-20260321-88. Pinning staff announce in #staff-announce and posting RN link.

maria_p: Posting internal announcement (paste below) and will pin after jordons post.

maria_p (to paste):
> Heads up — rolling v1.29.0 tonight (02:00-04:00 UTC). Runtime perf & cost improvements (KV-cache hotfix + updated quant profiles). Expected ~30% per-token cost reduction for streaming RLHF workloads. Canary EU; global promotion ~45-90m after canary if healthy. See RN: https://internal.docs/release/v1.29.0. Ops monitoring; rollback: >1.5% error-rate increase or P95 latency +200ms.

sachin: LGTM. Great work team :party_parrot:
